# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 19 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 12 tokens; Duration — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #14171d);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #14171d | Things that sit on the ground: cards, menus, ⌘K, toasts, inputs. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

```

### Tokens (19)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #ffffff | #0e1014 | Page and main-pane ground: lists, the thread pane, docs. |
| `--sidebar` | #f6f7f9 | #121419 | Sidebar, table headers, ⌘K footer, a seat doc's side rail. |
| `--raised` | #f2f4f7 | #1a1d24 | Hover and active rows, secondary buttons, tool-call blocks, avatar fills. |
| `--selected` | #fbf3f1 | #1d1719 | The selected row in a list (a 6% held tint). Text on it stays `text`. |
| `--line` | #e3e5ea | #262a33 | Hairlines between rows and around surfaces. Decorative: never the only edge of a control. |
| `--line-strong` | #cfd3db | #363b46 | Section rules and dividers that must read at a glance. |
| `--line-control` | #7f8693 | #666d7c | Input and checkbox borders (3:1 on bg and surface in both themes). |
| `--body` | #2b2f38 | #c3c7d0 | Running text in messages and docs, on bg, surface and raised. |
| `--muted` | #687080 | #858c9a | Metadata: cursors, times, handles, paths, counts, placeholders. On bg, sidebar, surface and raised (4.5:1 in both themes). |
| `--brand` | #d63f18 | #ff6a3d | Vermilion. The one primary action per view, the inbox count, the mark's now-stop. Never a background for more than a control. |
| `--held` | #c23a12 | #ff8a62 | Something is waiting on you: held kinds (approval, decision), the held pill, unread dots, focus. As text on bg, surface, held-soft and selected. |
| `--held-soft` | #f9ebe7 | #2b1f1d | Fill behind held pills, the held chip, and the ground of an approval card. |
| `--agent` | #0e7c86 | #4fc1c9 | Agent identity: square avatars, the working state, arrival tints, spend bars. As text on bg, surface and agent-soft. |
| `--agent-soft` | #f0f7f7 | #162529 | Fill of an agent's square avatar. |
| `--warning` | #9a6700 | #d4a72c | Budget kind, alert thresholds. Text on bg and surface. |
| `--danger` | #be123c | #fb7185 | Crimson. Failed, over budget, destructive outlines, field errors. Never a filled button, so it never reads as brand. |
| `--info` | #0969da | #6cb6ff | Review and proposal kinds, links inside docs. |
| `--success` | #1a7f37 | #3fb950 | Done task state and passing checks. Always paired with a check glyph or the word. |
| `--focus` | #c23a12 | #ff8a62 | Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface in both themes. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 620 26px/32px "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-title-xl); letter-spacing: -0.025em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title-xl` | `.title-xl`, `--text-title-xl` | 26px / 32px, letter-spacing -0.025em | 620 | `sans` | Doc and seat titles. |
| `title-lg` | `.title-lg`, `--text-title-lg` | 21px / 26px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | The thread pane's title. |
| `title-md` | `.title-md`, `--text-title-md` | 15px / 20px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `sans` | List and section headers. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Doc prose and charters. |
| `ui` | `.ui`, `--text-ui` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Everything in the app shell at compact density: rows, messages, menus. |
| `ui-strong` | `.ui-strong`, `--text-ui-strong` | 13px / 18px | 600 | `sans` | Unread titles, names, button labels. |
| `ui-comfortable` | `.ui-comfortable`, `--text-ui-comfortable` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | `ui` at comfortable density. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Hints, field help, secondary lines. |
| `mono-ui` | `.mono-ui`, `--text-mono-ui` | 11px / 16px | 400 | `mono` | Cursors, clock times, handles, paths, money. |
| `mono-label` | `.mono-label`, `--text-mono-label` | 10.5px / 16px | 500 | `mono` | Kinds, keyboard hints, sidebar group labels. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 12px / 18px | 400 | `mono` | Tool calls, config blocks, code in messages. |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Gap inside chips and between an icon and its label. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between controls in a row; sidebar padding. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Card and menu padding; gap between stacked fields. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | List-row side padding; cell padding. |
| `--space-5` | 22px | Thread-pane side padding. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between panels. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Doc page side padding. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Space between page sections. |
